title: Algebraic description of vector bundles on projective space
statement: For each \(n\geq0\), describe the finite-rank algebraic vector bundles on \(\mathbb P^n_{\mathbb C}\) up to isomorphism. The precise requested form in the notes is a classification by proper graded exterior-algebra modules up to adding graded free summands. This problem belongs to the manuscript lecture of 13 February 1978; its corrected GP-1977 identifier records the actual academic year, while this package retains the requested catalogue record.
status: Solved in the stated representation-theoretic sense by \citet[Theorem~1]{bernsteingelfandgelfand1978bundles}, received 10 January 1978 and published in the 1978 volume. Theorem~2 gives the derived categorical equivalence. No earlier problem ID in the supplied index states this exact projective-bundle problem; affine freeness (the Quillen--Suslin theorem) has different hypotheses.

title: Represent twisting by O(1) on the exterior-module side
statement: Given a proper graded exterior-algebra module \(V\), determine an operation whose associated bundle is \(\Phi(V)(1)\). The notes ask and answer this question within the same, miscatalogued 1978 lecture.
status: Solved: embed \(V\) into a finite graded free module, take the cokernel \(V^{\prime}\), and use \(W_j=V^{\prime}_{j+1}\). See \citet[remark~2 after Theorem~1]{bernsteingelfandgelfand1978bundles}. The fibre long exact sequence independently checks the shift.
